purpose: Reviewed static appointment-detail labels, management actions and review-form accessibility copy; preserve authored customer/salon data and navigation/payment behavior

Your service and professional are already selected for this appointment. Rate your experience and add a comment if you wish.

message_rows.en: If you have an experience that could help others, share it here...
